alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued July 31 at 8:41AM CDT until August 3 at 1:00AM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
alerts.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 20 kt tonight with waves 3 to 5 ft,
shifting to northeast winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt
and waves 4 to 7 ft Saturday into Sunday.

* WHERE...Nearshore Waters from Sheboygan to Winthrop Harbor IL.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Saturday to 1 AM CDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
